acceptance_rule.formula: accept iff margin - max(2*SE, abs(calibrated - uniform)) > 0 AND the sign agrees on a disjoint out-of-sample seed set
acceptance_rule.undecidable_rule: if SE > 20 the row is reported as undecidable; if the two-field term exceeds the effect the row is reported as undecidable on this apparatus
acceptance_rule.why_two_terms: 2*SE is statistical and shrinks with n; abs(calibrated - uniform) is apparatus bias and does NOT shrink with n, because the repo simulator places central gold uniformly over region 1 and so has no gradient inside the central 9x9 where the measured gradient lives

baseline.condition: extracted with git show and sha256-asserted before every build; src/player.cpp was never written by this line

boundaries: the 51.1% baseline behind the +17.6 pp gap has three known biases (older published build, self-selected challengers, unstratified) and the real starting point after the published slot got 18x faster is unknown, so +17.6 pp is an estimate not a measurement

every pp figure carries an unknown multiplier: the +40 gold ~ +2 pp rate uses the sigma of our own paired A/B dispersion while field-wide per-game sigma is larger, and a 4.7x discrepancy in the exchange rate is unresolved, so do not convert these gold figures to pp
everything is self-play against our own unmodified fd47ea6; transfer to the benchmark opponent is unverified
the local NPC model is over-greedy and over-central, which flatters any centre-local mechanism

the calibrated field recovers only ~75% of the measured gradient, which is why the two-field difference is printed on every row as a mandatory error term; its DIRECTION differs per candidate (+13.8..+26.6 for the cursor form, -7.6..-15.0 for the stack and colvedge), so a single global claim about simulator optimism would be wrong either way

simulator margins are gross of latency by construction because dispatch is fixed; the cost term is separate and for this candidate it is NEGATIVE, a favourable-direction correction, so it is reported under both weightings and neither is silently adopted

candidate_A_k_1_5.condition: nofoldpure + cursor5a, compared against base on the identical seed, order arm, field model and map
candidate_A_k_1_5.idea: k in {1,5} instead of {0,6}: leave the donor ONE step to walk back to its anchor
candidate_A_k_1_5.implementation_note: the donor retained step needs no new code: a blind unit target already IS its anchor, so its own first LUT action is already the step toward the anchor
candidate_A_k_1_5.income: see candidate_B_trigger_widening.income_* rows under arm a5
candidate_A_k_1_5.why: this line measured the reallocated tail moving the producer by under 0.05 rings and net INWARD on map2, yet the pooled mean ring rises +0.173 on BOTH units, so the drift is donor-freeze and donating all three slots is over-donation

candidate_B_trigger_widening.ceiling_verdict: CLOSED, and this is the mechanism ceiling rather than an implementation failure.  Gold per firing collapses 16x (0.520 -> 0.393 -> 0.263 -> 0.032) and the TOTAL falls monotonically the moment the trigger widens past blind (+107.6 at 41% -> +101.3 at 52% -> +84.1 at 64% -> +13.8 at 85%).  Marginal value falls faster than firing rate rises, immediately, so the blind trigger IS the optimum and the +265 linear extrapolation is refuted -- it extrapolated from the zero-opportunity-cost extreme.  The collapse mechanism is measured: mean ring rises monotonically with permissiveness (nc -0.047 inward -> f34 +0.090) while our own scoring rounds fall monotonically (-13.9 -> -57.7) and the opponent rise (+2.8) at full widening
candidate_B_trigger_widening.condition: each level is nofold or nofoldpure plus that predicate, compared against base on the identical seed, order arm, field model and map; map2 is judged first because it is the only convertible per-map line within reach

firing_rate_and_ring_drift.gate: a step-transfer arm must not raise the mean ring distance; fold_tour died because a three-step tour cannot return to its start on a parity board and walked the unit off the central generation peak

candidate_B_trigger_widening.idea: the reallocation machine is already paid for, so widen its trigger from "donor is blind" to "the two units reachable value is asymmetric"

levels.D34: always to the richer; D3 and D4 coincide

ladder_D.measure: popcount of the v>2 mask per window row, after the column mask and the row-in-range mask
ladder_D.verdict: DEAD ON COST, no games spent: +82.63 to +89.42 instructions same-stream, because the popcount has to sit inside the unrolled AVX row loop and that breaks the vectorised store pattern the delivered scan depends on

ladder_E.cost_note: with nofoldpure the E levels are +2.49..+6.11 above the same-stream baseline and are excluded by the at-or-below-baseline rule; paired with nofold (-61.01 on its own) every level is 35.5-39.2 BELOW baseline

levels.E1: donor best target in the outer half of the ring priority order

ladder_E.measure: bv, the winner of the EXISTING row-min reduction, encoding (ring_priority << 5) | window_index with 0xFFFF meaning no reachable rich cell; smaller bv = better reachable target and bv==0xFFFF is exactly blind, so it is a free ordinal proxy costing one saved int and one compare

contrasts_map2.condition: all four arms ran on the SAME map2 seeds, order arms and field models against the same baseline games, so each contrast is a like-for-like difference of two paired margins with a quadrature SE; the informative contrast is against the BETTER PARENT, because measuring against the common baseline double-counts nofold contribution

combination_g5.verdict: not an upgrade: it beats its better parent by +4.7 +- 27.6.  The two members are largely the same gain arriving by two routes

construct.note: the delivered fd47ea6 already carries asm('.space 96, 0x90') and its entry lands at mod64 == 0x10 unaided by any further pad, so a proposed '48-byte dead pad' is already banked; a 48-byte pad would put the entry at 0x20.  For every other variant the pad is re-tuned here until mod64 == 0x10, which is why no layout tax appears in any cost figure.

pad_question.condition: eleven separate builds of the delivered text with only the .space operand changed, each nm-ed for the moveDecision symbol, compared against the delivered pad of 96
pad_question.consequence: the entry moves one byte per pad byte, so any shift is absorbed in ONE step by pad = 96 + ((0x10 - mod64) mod 64), always in [96,159]; the position tax is a build step, not a cost, and no layout term appears in any cost figure
pad_question.resolved: the 48-byte dead pad is already banked and the candidate is dropped
pad_question.warning: do not infer which code precedes the entry from source order: the pad sits AFTER moveDecision and still moves it, and nofold / nofoldpure have identical .text sizes yet need different pads (144 vs 96).  Only nm is authoritative

per_map.condition: map2 and map3 use 50 tune (3000-3049) + 50 disjoint OOS (7000-7049) seeds, 2 order arms => 100 paired games per arm per field per band, each arm compared against the unmodified fd47ea6 on the identical seed, order arm and field model, with its own null control re-run on that map
per_map.why: a pooled number cannot be converted into win rate; the convertible per-map 50% lines against the benchmark opponent are map2 +86 (cheapest, near-linear), map3 +127 (convex), map1 +200 (outlier), pooled equal-weight +166

positioning_gates.residual_drift_mechanism: the +0.173 pooled ring drift appears on BOTH units while the tail geometry is flat and the donor takes zero steps, so the cause is that silencing a unit which was walking BACK to its anchor freezes it further out than the anchor.  This gives a precondition to the previously unexplained fold_never ~ 0: standing still is as good as oscillating ONLY when the unit is already AT its anchor
positioning_gates.ring_condition: per-unit mean L1 ring from (8,8) at round end, rounds >= 8, calibrated field, 16 paired games, compared against the same-seed baseline; the instrument agrees with two independent harnesses to 0.07-0.11 rings
positioning_gates.tail_condition: each .so replayed over three REAL platform logs; positions come from the logged input and actions from the .so own output, so nothing here depends on a simulator field model, and each tail slot ring is compared against the SAME unit ring after step 3 in the SAME round
positioning_gates.verdict: gate passes: donor span is a no-op on 100% of firing rounds on all three maps, the tail moves the producer by under 0.05 rings and is net inward on map2, and the ring>=5 share is explained by the producer starting ring (map3 control: producers at mean ring 1.737, share collapses to 2.3%)
positioning_gates.why: fold_tour died at -81.4 +- 18.5 because a three-step tour cannot close on a parity board and walked the unit off the central generation peak; two further candidates died the same way, so any step-transfer arm must show it is not reproducing it

process_failure_recorded.what: a construct run overwrote base.so while 24 A/B workers were dlopen-ing it; the run died with "file too short" and lost an nc measurement at 1001/4800 games
process_failure_recorded.why_recorded: the loud failure was luck.  Had the rebuild finished a millisecond earlier, half the paired comparisons in that run would have been measured against one build and half against another, with no error, no warning and a plausible-looking margin.  Never write a build directory an A/B is reading

step1_coarse_screen.condition: closed-loop self-play on map1, dispatch fixed, each arm compared against the unmodified fd47ea6 on the identical seed, order arm and field model

step2_stacked_verdict.condition: as step 1 but at 300 paired games per cell; integrity verified with 300 distinct scenario digests per field, disjoint between the two field models
step2_stacked_verdict.purpose: the only measurement that decides; immune to multiple comparisons, to the additivity assumption, and to interaction pricing, because interaction is already inside the number
step2_stacked_verdict.seeds: 150 tune (3000-3149) + 150 disjoint OOS (7000-7149), 2 order arms => 300 paired games per arm per field per band, map1

step3_leave_one_out.condition: each arm is the stack with exactly one member removed, compared against base on the identical seed, order arm and field model, so the difference between a row and the stack row is that member contribution INSIDE the stack
step3_leave_one_out.purpose: attribution: with k members this is k measurements rather than k(k-1)/2 pairs, and it answers which member to drop
step3_leave_one_out.seeds: 100 tune (3000-3099) + 100 disjoint OOS (7000-7099), 2 order arms => 200 paired games per arm per field per band, map1
